Name: BASECHR_SELECT_MENU_PARAM_ST
Description: Starting classes in character creation. Every row is listed in ID order; picking one applies its CharaInitParam rows to the new character. Rows 1000-1999 are used only by the network-test build mode and are hidden otherwise; rows 2010 and 2011 are listed only with a specific DLC or entitlement.

Fields.Name: Chara Init Param ID - Appearance
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam row applied in full when the class is picked (appearance, and everything else the row sets). The character's body type is added: this ID for Body Type A, this ID + 1 for Body Type B. Retail: the "Face - <class>" rows (3100, 3102 ...). The first listed row is also applied when character creation opens.

Fields.Name: Chara Init Param ID - Class
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam row of the class itself, applied after the appearance row. ID % 100 is saved as the character's class (origin). Retail: the "Class - <class>" rows 3000-3011.

Fields.Name: Image ID
Fields.Description: Picture shown for the class in the selection list. Retail: 1-17.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Class name (Menu Text) shown in the list. In the network-test build mode, text ID + 10 is used as the preset character name.
